# Volume VII: Testing, Commissioning, Integrated Systems Testing, and Closeout

This volume provides the commercial governance framework for the five-level data center commissioning hierarchy (Level 1 FAT Red Tag through Level 5 IST White Tag), temporary resistive/reactive and liquid-cooled load bank fleets, utility and fuel burn-in budgeting, retesting liability matrices, and COBie 5D BIM handover.
